mapper.sql: COALESCE( (SELECT R.NICKNAME FROM T_RELATIONSHIP R WHERE R.KINDERGARTEN_ID = N.KINDERGARTEN_ID AND R.USER_ID = N.AUTHOR), (SELECT U.NAME FROM T_USER U WHERE U.ID = N.AUTHOR) ) AUTHOR_NAME
mapper.select:
SELECT N.ID, N.KINDERGARTEN_ID, N.NUM, N.TITLE, N.CONTENT, N.AUTHOR, N.PINNED, N.BANNER_ENABLED, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(N.CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(N.UPDATED_AT) * 1000 UPDATED_AT,
FROM T_NOTICE N WHERE N.KINDERGARTEN_ID = #{kindergartenId} ORDER BY N.PINNED DESC, N.NUM DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_NOTICE(KINDERGARTEN_ID, NUM, TITLE, PINNED, BANNER_ENABLED, CONTENT, AUTHOR) VALUES (#{kindergartenId}, (SELECT IFNULL(MAX(N.NUM), 0) + 1 FROM T_NOTICE N WHERE N.KINDERGARTEN_ID = #{kindergartenId}), #{title}, #{pinned}, #{bannerEnabled}, #{content}, #{author})
mapper.select:
SELECT N.ID, N.KINDERGARTEN_ID, N.NUM, N.TITLE, N.CONTENT, N.AUTHOR, N.PINNED, N.BANNER_ENABLED, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(N.CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(N.UPDATED_AT) * 1000 UPDATED_AT,
FROM T_NOTICE N WHERE N.ID = #{id}
